top_signals.title: Blackstone-Backed QTS Kicks Off Data-Center Bond at Hefty Cost
top_signals.summary: Blackstone-backed QTS Realty Trust Inc. units kicked off a high-grade bond sale to help fund construction of a data center tied to Microsoft Corp., offering a hefty yield to drum up demand from investors who’ve become more selective about what they’re willing to buy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
